verdict.rationale: Community reports show bulk import at scale working: ~80M documents across 13 indexes after batch indexing was introduced, a 7M-article corpus, 1M records on a small instance, and indexing described as roughly 10x faster than Elasticsearch. First-party docs only mention adding documents generically, and nothing in the pack covers async task tracking or indexing-completion status. Caveats are real: batch indexing is memory-intensive, default upload size limits are too low, and indexing fell behind for hours under constant writes. Missing for 10: any evidence of an async task/status API for tracking indexing completion, first-party docs on bulk/batch import throughput and payload limits, and predictable memory and performance under heavy write loads.
